text_en: The Lord is king! Let the earth rejoice; let the many coastlands be glad!
text_cn: 上主为王！愿大地踊跃， 无数岛屿，也都要欢乐！

text_en: Clouds and thick darkness are all around him; righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.
text_cn: 云彩和黑暗将他团团包围， 正义与公道支持他的座位。

text_en: Fire goes before him, and consumes his adversaries on every side.
text_cn: 烈火在他前面先行， 焚烧他四周的敌人。

text_en: His lightnings light up the world; the earth sees and trembles.
text_cn: 他的闪电照亮尘寰， 大地一见，战栗摇撼。

text_en: The mountains melt like wax before the Lord , before the Lord of all the earth.
text_cn: 面对上主，即普世的主宰， 大山要像蜡烛一般溶解。

text_en: The heavens proclaim his righteousness; and all the peoples behold his glory.
text_cn: 苍天宣扬他的公道， 万民目睹他的光耀。

text_en: All worshipers of images are put to shame, those who make their boast in worthless idols; all gods bow down before him.
text_cn: 愿所有拜偶像，以邪神自夸的人受辱， 愿所有的神祇，都俯伏在他面前叩首。

text_en: Zion hears and is glad, and the towns of Judah rejoice, because of your judgments, O God.
text_cn: 上主，因你的审判，熙雍听见了便喜笑， 犹大各城高兴欢跃。

text_en: For you, O Lord , are most high over all the earth; you are exalted far above all gods.
text_cn: 上主，你在普天下是最尊贵的， 你在众神中，是最崇高的。

text_en: The Lord loves those who hate evil; he guards the lives of his faithful; he rescues them from the hand of the wicked.
text_cn: 上主喜爱那恼恨罪恶的人， 保护虔诚人们的生命， 从恶人手中拯救他们。

text_en: Light dawns for the righteous, and joy for the upright in heart.
text_cn: 光明已升起照耀着义人， 赐喜乐于心地正直的人。

text_en: Rejoice in the Lord , O you righteous, and give thanks to his holy name!
text_cn: 义人们，请因上主而欢欣， 并请你们赞美他的圣名。
